beats.summary: Darryl invites Val and Nate to a Christmas party upstairs, describing it as a fun event with food and drinks.

evidence.snippet: Darryl: Oh yeah, and um there's a Christmas party upstairs tonight, wanted to tell you about.
Darryl: Well you should definitely come. The foreman always comes. Plus it's fun, you know cookies, smoked fish, alcohol, people acting stupid.

beats.summary: Jim suspects Dwight is trying to entrap him to get his bonus and is concerned about drinking at the party.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Dwight really wants my bonus. He's trying to entrap me.

beats.summary: Robert encourages Erin to take a shot at the party, and the group joins in drinking shots together.

evidence.snippet:
Erin: OK.
[STAGE] takes shot, group laughs

beats.summary: Jim reveals that Dwight used his credit card to send a $200 bouquet of flowers to Jim's wife.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So Dwight did take the bait. He used my credit card numbers to send a two hundred dollar bouquet of flowers, to my wife…from me.

beats.summary: Dwight claims he was attacked by a porcupine placed in his desk drawer and suspects someone is trying to set him up.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Ah! I've been attacked! Oh my god! Oh! Someone put a porcupine in my drawer!
Dwight: Or who in this office knows that I have access and is trying to set me up?

beats.summary: Jim calls animal control to remove the porcupine named Henrietta from the office.

evidence.snippet: Jim (on phone): Yes, I'm calling from Dunder Mifflin. We have a very rabid porcupine in our office, someone should come pick it up.

Jim: And what's it's name?
Dwight: Henrietta.
